title: Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Veterans Memorial Coliseum on 1990-03-28
lineage: MAC > Sony TC-D5M (Dolby off) > Marantz CDR-500 > EAC > Wav > Soundforge > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC. Taped and transferred by Andrew F.
source: AUD (Changed mics between sets). Set One: Nakamichi CM-300's with CP-4 shotguns. Set Two: Sennheiser MD-441's. Mics > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell MX 90/100 tape, with no Dolby. Mics on 7-foot stands, in front row of OTS.

ai_review.summary: Audience recording praised for its depth, punch and energy, delivering a vivid live experience despite no show details.
ai_review.review: The reviewer lauds Andrew's audience tape, noting it has a depth, punch and energy that board recordings often lack. While no specific musical moments are mentioned, the strong positive tone suggests the performance was enjoyable to listen to through this lively recording.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one detailed review; it highlights excellent recording quality but provides no insight into the musical performance, so rating reflects strong tape quality with limited show information.
